sources.title: Broncos met with the top linebacker prospects at the Combine
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos had formal interviews with multiple linebackers at the NFL Scouting Combine, including Ohio State’s Sonny Styles, Texas Tech’s Jacob Rodriguez, Cincinnati’s Jake Golday, and Missouri’s Josiah Trotter.
